text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats getting first place! It's 
the greatest feeling.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Cutting through the wind and gaining the 
lead… no matter how many times I 
experience this, something starts welling 
up within my chest every time.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I was able to see a great scenery. How 
about you?
